_metadata.description: Qualified output and renderer profiles; evidence is linked per requirement and completion is derived by the owner.

requirements.title: The exporter shall qualify the accepted SDR output profiles.
requirements.description: The exporter shall produce and verify 1920x1080 and 1080x1920 video at 24 and 30fps SDR, square pixels, declared color/range and duration/frame schedule, plus supported high-resolution stills without invented source detail.

validation.notes: Executed public four-profile matrix, independent full decode/PTS/color metadata, root sample review, and supported native2560x1440 still. Root manual attestation recorded by business-health on2026-10-21. Absence of an emitted SAR field is explicitly documented as default square-pixel interpretation. No native4K detail, HDR, global color/readability or full release claim. Declared status awaits owner reconciliation.

requirements.title: The release shall qualify source adequacy and readable proof.
requirements.description: Before final acceptance, the shot shall evaluate capture/plate resolution, projected required text footprint, masking, crop and proof hold intervals at final viewing size and reject inadequate required content.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-OUTPUT-READABILITY protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

requirements.title: The renderer shall preserve declared source and beauty color policies.
requirements.description: The pipeline shall separate UI-faithful screen treatment from beauty lighting, record input/output color transforms/range and qualify native/portable results without claiming bit-identical pixels across hardware.
